concepts.name: Sahara
concepts.definition: The world's largest hot desert, spanning about 9.2 million km² across North Africa from the Atlantic to the Red Sea, roughly 31% of the continent.

concepts.name: Arabian Desert
concepts.definition: The largest desert in Asia, occupying almost the entire Arabian Peninsula across some 2.3 million km² and eleven countries, and containing the vast Rub' al-Khali sand sea.

concepts.name: Gobi Desert
concepts.definition: Large cold desert of southern Mongolia and northern China, spanning about 1.3 million km² of mostly bare rock and gravel rather than sand.

concepts.name: Taklamakan Desert
concepts.definition: Vast shifting-sand desert filling the Tarim Basin of Xinjiang in northwest China, ringed by the Kunlun, Pamir and Tian Shan mountains.

concepts.name: Kalahari Desert
concepts.definition: Large semi-arid sandy savanna of southern Africa covering about 900,000 km² across Botswana, Namibia and South Africa; its name means "the great thirst."

concepts.name: Namib Desert
concepts.definition: Ancient coastal desert running over 2,000 km along the Atlantic shore of Namibia, Angola and northwest South Africa; possibly the world's oldest desert.

concepts.name: Atacama Desert
concepts.definition: The driest non-polar desert on Earth, stretching about 1,600 km along northern Chile's Pacific coast between the Andes and the Coast Range.

concepts.name: Thar Desert
concepts.definition: Also the Great Indian Desert, an arid region of about 264,000 km² straddling the India–Pakistan border, mostly in Rajasthan; the world's most densely populated desert.

concepts.name: Karakum Desert
concepts.definition: "Black Sand" desert of Central Asia covering roughly 70% of Turkmenistan, crossed by the Karakum Canal and home to the burning Darvaza gas crater.

concepts.name: Kyzylkum Desert
concepts.definition: "Red Sand" desert of Central Asia lying between the Amu Darya and Syr Darya rivers across Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan.

concepts.name: Mojave Desert
concepts.definition: The smallest and driest of North America's deserts, centred on southeastern California and southern Nevada; home to Death Valley and the endemic Joshua tree.

concepts.name: Sonoran Desert
concepts.definition: Hot desert of the southwestern US (Arizona, California) and northwestern Mexico, the only place the saguaro cactus grows wild and the most plant-rich desert on Earth.

concepts.name: Chihuahuan Desert
concepts.definition: The largest hot desert in North America, spanning northern Mexico and parts of Arizona, New Mexico and Texas; among the world's most biologically diverse deserts.

concepts.name: Great Victoria Desert
concepts.definition: Australia's largest desert, covering about 348,750 km² of sandhills, plains and salt lakes across Western Australia and South Australia.

concepts.name: Great Sandy Desert
concepts.definition: Australia's second-largest desert, covering about 285,000 km² across northern Western Australia and extending east into the Northern Territory.

concepts.name: Simpson Desert
concepts.definition: Arid region of red sandy plains and dunes in central Australia, spanning the Northern Territory, South Australia and Queensland, with the world's longest parallel sand dunes.

concepts.name: Dasht-e Kavir
concepts.definition: The Great Salt Desert, a large arid plateau of salt marshes and flats covering about 77,600 km² across central Iran.

concepts.name: Dasht-e Lut
concepts.definition: Large salt desert in southeastern Iran (Kerman and Sistan-Baluchestan provinces), recording Earth's hottest land surface temperature of 70.7 °C.

concepts.name: Betpak-Dala
concepts.definition: Cold, sharply continental desert steppe in central Kazakhstan, lying between the Sarysu and Chu rivers and Lake Balkhash.

concepts.name: Caatinga
concepts.definition: Semi-arid thorn-scrub region of interior northeastern Brazil, the country's only exclusively Brazilian biome.

concepts.name: Libyan Desert
concepts.definition: Hyper-arid section of the eastern Sahara spanning Libya, Egypt, and Sudan, home to the Gilf Kebir plateau.

concepts.name: Nubian Desert
concepts.definition: Hot desert in the eastern Sahara across northeastern Sudan and northern Eritrea, between the Nile River and the Red Sea.

concepts.name: Rub' al Khali
concepts.definition: Vast sand desert covering much of the southern Arabian Peninsula, the world's largest contiguous sand sea.

concepts.name: Syrian Desert
concepts.definition: Rocky, semi-arid plateau spanning Syria, Jordan, Iraq, and Saudi Arabia between the Orontes Valley and the Euphrates River.

concepts.name: Western Desert
concepts.definition: Hot Saharan desert west of the Nile covering roughly two-thirds of Egypt, extending into Libya, dotted with oases.
